_comment: Copied into the database on first start; new keys are added on later starts, existing ones are left alone (manage them on the admin page). categories: category key -> confidence given to every item of the feed. Only official RSS/Atom feeds the publisher offers for syndication are listed; we store headline, short description, image URL and link, never the full article. Review each publisher's terms before enabling it for a public or commercial bot (see README, 'Providers and licensing').
